svg.title: Push growth per person in 2026 Q1, relative to 2020 Q1
svg.desc: Cumulative growth in public GitHub pushes per resident, 2020 Q1 to 2026 Q1, using UN World Population Prospects 2024 population on 1 January of each endpoint year. 2020 population is an estimate; 2026 is a medium-variant projection. Bars and labels show percentage growth from the common baseline. Selected growing countries, not a complete ranking: Philippines +1036.4%; UAE +1019.5%; India +858.7%; Indonesia +659.6%; Thailand +633.5%; Japan +330.8%; United States +160.8%; Ireland +155.9%. Main analysis covers the same 149 economies as the article; all have matched population data. Economies with no reported 2020 Q1 baseline are not assigned zero or a later start. A push is not a fixed amount of code. This is not a causal AI effect or individual productivity measure.
